Upgrading to a new iPhone often comes with a hidden extra cost: if the new and old models are different sizes, you'll need to buy a new case.

Those who upgrade their Pro models to the iPhone 18 Pro this year will almost inevitably need to buy a new case — though two accessory makers have differing views on this, and one has made an even bolder prediction…

Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter of an Otterbox case, pointing out that the product is already listed on Best Buy and is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom-right corner of the packaging reads in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself isn't entirely convinced, adding: "It's still too early to draw conclusions." However, Matt Ronge, founder of Astropad, which primarily makes anti-glare screen protectors for iPhones, said his suppliers have told him the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, a leaker claimed that at the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but sources within the iPhone supply chain say the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimeters thicker than its predecessor.

That trend seems to be continuing, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

However, not all leakers agree — some claim the iPhone 18 Pro Max will have the exact same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide case manufacturers with dimensions in advance so third-party cases can launch alongside new iPhones. On the other hand, accessory makers sometimes place production orders based purely on rumors, which aren't always accurate. Personally, I wouldn't buy a case before a new iPhone is officially announced.
